reviews.text: Picked up a stray puppy, and the staff at Rutherford were outstanding. They explained a treatment plan that would help the puppy get healthy. I asked a lot of questions, and they took the time to answer them all. Dr. Woolley and the vet assistant were so kind. The puppy found a loving home.
Many years of excellent care from a team that goes the extra mile for their patients. Can't say enough good things about this practice and those who work there!
i've never ever had a negative experience here. i trust dr. rowan and all the staff here completely.
I have been going to Rutherford Veterinary Hospital for several years now.  Dr. Rowan and staff have always given excellent service to my dogs.  I completely trust them.
Love these guys! I take my pets here. They do shots, diagnosis, even boarding. Friendly bilingual staff.

I have had a mixed experience with this vet practice. On one hand, I am satisfied with the care received once we are in office being seen, however I have had issues otherwise.

I have three dogs and all three of them are on Bravecto as their flea and tick preventative. For cost reasons, I do not buy this directly from the vet and have all three dogs' flea and tick preventatives on autoship.

For some reason I can't quite understand, Bravecto needs prescription or vet approval. When I first established with this vet, they insisted on seeing our dogs before approving Bravecto. Having an appointment scheduled is not good enough. This is inconvenient but I dealt with it.

A year later and I have my dog's annual appointment scheduled for right around the time he's due for his vaccination boosters. I get a call from Rutherford stating that they could not approve my scheduled Bravecto shipment because they had not seen my dog recently. This call was made despite my dog being an established patient that had been seen twice last year and having an upcoming appointment less than two months away.

Vet appointments are wildly expensive anymore and as someone with three dogs, I try to spread their appointments out somewhat to lessen the financial blow. They were asking me to bump up my dog's appointment when my other two dogs were scheduled to be seen later in the week. When I mentioned that, they said they could approve a month's supply of Bravecto for my third dog to get me by until his appointment. This was confusing as one dose of Bravecto lasts 12 weeks, and I feel like a vet office should know that. I even mentioned this to the person I spoke with and despite this, they kept mentioning they would talk to the vet to get a one month supply approved.

Then when we took two of our other dogs in to be seen, they tried telling us one of our dogs was not on the schedule when he was.

At times, this practice does not seem to be organized due to the aforementioned. And while I understand there are regulations, I think it's ridiculous that they call about potentially not approving a simple flea and tick preventative for an established patient that has an upcoming appointment.

I made the switch from the previous vet to hopefully support a local private own clinic. I had high hopes based off of the initial phone call, however upon checking in, we were met with a cold reception, techs and doctor. Not sure if it was anything that we did considering how we were seated in a room so there was not much interaction that we could’ve done. We will not be coming back unfortunately.

I am on my third dog, All of them have gone here. I started with Dr. Vaughn and the new doctors are excellent as well.
Convenient location.
Our first visit here was wonderful. The vet and tech really care about pets. They were so very gentle with my cat Pearl. I'm def coming back.

Rutherford Veterinary Hospital took care of our dog for their entire life, and we could not have asked for a more compassionate, knowledgeable, and supportive team. From routine visits to more difficult moments, they always treated our dog with so much kindness and respect, and they treated us like family. Their genuine care, patience, and professionalism meant everything to us over the years. We will always be incredibly grateful for the amazing care they provided and the love they showed our dog every step of the way. We truly cannot thank them enough.
Honest and trustworthy.

I’m extremely particular about who I trust with my dog, and Rutherford Veterinary Clinic has exceeded my expectations every single time. From routine visits to bigger procedures, I’ve always felt confident that Olaf is genuinely cared for here — not just treated, but truly looked after.

Dr. Woolley is truly the best — she is compassionate, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in Olaf’s well-being. I never feel rushed, and all of my questions are answered thoughtfully, which gives me so much peace of mind.

Olaf was also neutered here, and the entire experience was very positive from start to finish. The communication was clear, the care was excellent, and I felt reassured every step of the way.

If you’re looking for a vet who truly cares and makes you feel comfortable leaving your pet in their hands, I couldn’t recommend this clinic more.

Zero stars if I could. Absolutely unprofessional. Spoke to Isabel on Wednesday for isolation boarding for the following Tuesday. I was told to send my dog’s vet records cause they did have availability and was told I’d get a call back once the vet has reviewed them. I had to call them back on Friday since I hadn’t heard from them just to be told they actually couldn’t board my dog. I’m glad I followed up but I’m absolutely disappointed with how this was handled.

I took my dog there because I suspected that she got stung by a bug and the doctor convinced me that the problem whas a stick on her throat, I panicked and agreed for anesthesia but there was no stick, when I got home her face started to swell the doctor ignored the swollen lips and gave her anesthesia now im scared because my dogs face is swollen and will take her somewhere else , i will request all notes and all the "results " that lead to my dog to get anesthesia   when she had possibly been bit by a bug is that even safe vet practices?

Bella has been having a challenge with her allergy’s for a while and thanks to the Dr’s, it appears to have been on the path of recovery.

Now I must say, a big Thank you to the staff, who are always kind, helpful and friendly to my furry family.

Thank you to all the Doctors that continue to help me and people like me with their furry family. I am so glad that they speak my Dogs language because I don’t.
♥️🐾♥️🐾♥️🐾♥️🐾🙏
Friendly staff, great service.
Rutherford has always provided excellent care to our pets over the years it's close and they also offer doggie day care.

Dr. Woolley and staff were the absolute best. They listen to me, provide all necessary information, read the room, and most importantly treat my sweet Ruby like the queen that she is! Highly recommend and so happy I chose to establish care here with Dr. Woolley.
Dr. Woolley and the vet technician were absolutely wonderful with my dog. They performed a very thorough examination, all while my dog thought she was getting the ultimate amount of pets.
Love them!

Dr. Rowan and her team are the best veterinarians I can imagine. There is no one else I would rather trust my pets with than the good people at Rutherford. Amazing boarding and day care facilities as well. THANK YOU
Great Place For Veterinarian visits ...they take Care of Your pets

We took our corgi here for all his veterinary needs and always had a great experience! We also boarded him here a few times and he had a great time. They sent plenty of pictures and he always seemed well taken care of when he came home. Wish we lived closer so we could continue bringing him here!

The veterinarians and assistants at Rutherford veterinary hospital seem to truly care about dogs. They take a thorough medical history and listen to your detailed symptoms about what's going on with the dog. They asked questions to try to get to the root of the problem. They were very kind and gentle. I would recommend them to anyone.

Why do they add so many vaccine fees that they claim are mandatory after you've already left your pet and can't pick it up to take it with you? I think they should tell you before you leave it because a stay that we estimated would cost at most $400 went up to $800. I didn't like that they didn't show me where my dog ​​was going to stay.

I use Rutherford regularly for boarding my dog and they take such great care. Their socialite package includes receiving daily photos of your dog which always makes me feel cared for and reassured that my dog is enjoying their stay. It’s like a little vacation for them when I’m out of town. Fairly reasonably priced too.
They were very kind and helped me take care of my scared dog. They explained things to me when I didn't understand.
Great place, Wonderful stAff
If this company was 100 miles away, I would make that trip without hesitation. I love Rutherford. 10 👍's up. 🫶 …
Dr Washington was so sweet and helpful!

I love that they always call after a visit and are so responsive.  Spy had a bout of diarrhea and they took him in, ran the test and gave prescription medicine.  They called, as usual, after the visit to check on him, talked us through the diagnosis and treatment.  They are rock stars!

After trying out 3 other vets I found the only one I'll ever use in Dallas. The staff, the Dr, the facilities and overall experience was unlike any I'd ever had. Friendly and caring staff who prove how much they love their clients!
Excellent veterinarian on hand - Dr Rowan
Great vet and boarding combination. I drive 45 minutes to use them

I can't say enough good things about this vet. They were my vet for my dog throughout his whole life, and I couldn't of asked for a better vet partner to care for him. I will absolutely be going to them for every pet I ever have.
We have been going to Rutherford for 20 years. Dr. Rowan is wonderful with our pets - taking the time to listen to us and love on our pets.
The doc was great!
Takes great care of all our pets! Not a vet roll up with poor service. They truly care about your animals.

We wish we could attend today's Century Celebration of Rutherford! Wow 100 yrs! Dr. Rowan and her amazing team have made the lives so much better and no doubt longer of Mac the Dog and his silly kitty siblings, Oscar, Sketchy and Mr. Davis. Thank you! And have fun today 😸 …
The entire staff is friendly and helpful. Everyone answered all my questions and gave me the do's and do not's for my specific breed. Thank you ladies!!

On vacation traveling with our dog, Libbie, when she had developed a UTI. I had reached out her local vet for a prescription. Thankfully, RVH was about a mile away. I was able to setup Libbie as a patient, discussed her symptoms and previous treatments. I left with a fresh prescription for Libbie.

Everyone was extremely helpful and friendly. Really impressed with their services such as pick up and drop off, boarding and daycare.
Very personable and they always get my dogs in for services they need even when last minute. A bit expensive compared to a PetSmart but the quality of service is great.
Awesome vet
The personal make us feel very confortable, especially our little friends doggie feel special!!
Exceptional care and very friendly and caring! I've been going to Rutherford Veterinary for years! I won't go anywhere else for my pets care! ❤️

I came here because my previous pets have came and I liked the staff, but I don’t think I’ll be back after I came for an office visit. It took sometime for me to checkout while handling my dog. Definitely not a place for someone on a budget either. I didn’t think it’d be bad since the office visit charge isn’t outrageous, but after checking prices online for the medication my pet was prescribed, I realized you can definitely save a lot more money elsewhere.

For over 2 decades I have trusted Rutherford to care for my pets. They care about their patients and spend time petting and talking with them. And they know what they're doing. I am thankful they are my dogs' vet!

They could not perform the needed surgery here yet they still charged me 400 dollars for checking the dog knowing dam well I really needed the money to go elsewhere I am never coming back here again these are sick people !
